-- Find 2nd Highest Salary per Department using DENSE_RANK()
WITH RankedSalaries AS (
  SELECT 
    employee_id,
    department_id,
    salary,
    DENSE_RANK() OVER (PARTITION BY department_id ORDER BY salary DESC) AS rk
  FROM employees
)
SELECT employee_id, department_id, salary
FROM RankedSalaries
WHERE rk = 2;

2. Why we use it: Window functions allow you to calculate running totals or find top salaries without losing individual row details.
3. Easy Rule: Always use PARTITION BY to group rows and ORDER BY to sort rows inside the window function.
